plan.diagnosis_summary: Node_2 is the only actionable fault: its label indicators are uniformly ~2.5x worse than peers across all non-exempt classes (noise 0.1091 vs ~0.042, conflict 0.0671 vs ~0.022, confidence 0.6455 vs ~0.815, cv_macro_f1 0.5453 vs ~0.71), indicating localized label corruption. Its flagged quantile shifts are legitimate Non-IID, not unit drift: positive-only medians match peers (tcprtt p50_pos 0.1039 vs 0.1059/0.1061, djit 129.7 vs 130.4/130.8) and conservation ratios stay at 1.0/0.901/0.876 like healthy nodes. export_shard_code is a benign cross-node metadata column (MI 0.0-0.005, no missing canonical counterpart) so it is not renamed or dropped, and no feature shows single-node-only MI, so there is no shortcut column.
